sm_a_book_of_names.accept_text: Take the road east into Eastern Tirisfal for the Monastery. Mercer keeps to the Closed Stacks, off the long hall in the Library. She'll shut your casters down if she can, so bring someone who hits things. The ledger doesn't leave her desk.

sm_a_letter_for_brill.description: I've got a friend in Brill who isn't Forsaken and isn't Horde, and who's never once asked me what I am. His name's Flamewarden Teodor Novak. He watches the Scarlet Monastery for an order called the Pale Flame, and he needs people who can fight. I've written to him about you. I'd like you to carry the letter yourself, so he can see who I mean.
sm_a_letter_for_brill.accept_text: Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal and walk down into Brill. Novak keeps a room over the inn, and he doesn't bite.

sm_doans_codex.description: I collect what the living throw away, and Arcanist Doan has something I'd like very much. He's spent years in the Athenaeum at the top of the Monastery's Library, writing a codex of everything he's learned about the dead. It also covers how to end them, which is the part that worries me. I'd like to read it before Doan uses it on anyone else. Bring it to me, and I'll keep it out of the Crusade's hands for good.
sm_doans_codex.accept_text: The Athenaeum's the hall of shelves at the north end of the Library. When Doan's close to dying, he'll try to take the room with him.

sm_drilled_to_die.description: I keep finding Scarlet Soldiers dead in the hills, boys from Southshore who are barely old enough to lift a sword. The Crusade drills them in the Training Grounds of the Monastery's Armory. The man doing the drilling is one of the newcomers, a Sergeant Major Cole Brennan, and he's very good at it. I want Brennan dead and the yard emptied of Scarlet Soldiers. I'd rather fight soldiers than children.
sm_drilled_to_die.accept_text: The Armory's the middle door, and the Training Grounds are the yard inside. Brennan calls recruits in waves, so guard your healer.
sm_drilled_to_die.turn_in_text:
The newcomers brought a lot of things with them. Some of them brought this, apparently.

I'd rather fight soldiers than children, and you've made that likelier.

sm_hearts_of_zeal.description: I want to know what the Crusade puts in its faithful. The Scarlet Torturers and the Scarlet Scryers in the Monastery's Graveyard carry little vials of anointing oil. I think there's more in it than oil. Bring me the vials, and I'll find out what makes a man burn his neighbours and sing while he does it. I've seen what they do with it, and I'd like to know how.
sm_hearts_of_zeal.accept_text: The Torturers and the Scryers keep to the halls and the Chamber of Atonement in the Graveyard. Don't drink any of it.

sm_pages_for_sun_rock.description: I've read Doan's codex through, and one chapter has troubled me. Doan studied the dead that rise far from the Scourge, with no necromancer behind them, and he wrote down how it starts. I've heard the dead are rising like that in Mulgore. I've copied the chapter for Spiritwalker Tohana at Sun Rock Retreat, in Stonetalon, who watches that border. I'd like it carried to him, by someone who won't lose it.
sm_pages_for_sun_rock.accept_text: Take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar and a wind rider to Sun Rock. Tell Tohana the arcanist was wrong about a great deal, but not about this.

sm_the_champion_of_the_hall.description: I keep a list of the Crusade's people who matter, and Herod is near the top of it. He's their champion, and he holds the Hall of Champions at the back of the Armory. Lately he's been sending his trainees down the road to Brill to practise. I want that to stop, and I don't much care how. Put him down, and the road will be quieter for everyone.
sm_the_champion_of_the_hall.accept_text: The Hall of Champions is the last room of the Armory. Herod spins when he's angry, so keep moving, and don't stand in the doorway.

sm_the_hounds_of_the_library.description: I lost two scouts on the Hillsbrad road last month, run down by Scarlet hounds. I tracked the hounds back to the kennels in the Monastery's Library, and to the man who breeds them, Houndmaster Loksey. I want Loksey dead, and his Scarlet Tracking Hounds with him. Their families deserve to hear that the dogs are gone. It's not much, but it's what I can give them.
sm_the_hounds_of_the_library.accept_text: The kennels are in Huntsman's Cloister, at the top of the Library. Kill the hounds first, or they'll lick his wounds closed.

sm_the_monasterys_dead.description: I've buried half of Brill, and some of them twice. The burial ground at the Scarlet Monastery was Lordaeron's before it was the Crusade's, and the people lying in it were somebody's family. They don't rest any more. The Anguished Dead claw their way up out of the graves in the Forlorn Cloister, and the Haunting Phantasms drift among the stones. I want them laid down, gently if you can manage it, and any way you can if you can't.
sm_the_monasterys_dead.accept_text: The Monastery's east of here, up the road. Go into the Graveyard, through the crypt chapel, to the open burial ground with the mausoleum.

sm_the_preacher_in_the_nave.description: I keep the Forsaken chapel in Tarren Mill, and I still pray, which makes me strange even here. I've heard about a preacher in the Scarlet Cathedral, Brother Corwin Ashe, one of the newcomers. He fills the nave every night and sends the faithful out to burn. Faith is the one thing I was allowed to keep, and I don't want to watch it used like that. Stop him, and I'll pray for him afterwards, because somebody should.
sm_the_preacher_in_the_nave.accept_text: The Cathedral's the right-hand door. Go up past the gardens into the Crusader's Chapel. His sermon shields him, so keep at him.

sm_the_scout_in_the_cells.turn_in_text:
She was alive, then, and she's on her way here.

I was a firefighter in Brno before all this. You learn to count who comes out. I'm still counting.

sm_the_sleepless.turn_in_text:
I felt something loosen, I think, a long way off.

The dead there aren't ours, but the dead are the dead.
